season.name: Winter
season.line: The dark season is holy ground.

movement.name: The Dark Ground
movement.line: Begin where God began: in the dark, and not alone.

days.t: Weeping for a night, joy in the morning
x: For anger is in his wrath, but life in his favour: weeping shall tarry for the evening, but joy shall be in the morning.

days.t: Why are you so sad, O my soul?
x: Wherefore art thou very sad, O my soul? and wherefore dost thou trouble me? hope in God; for I will give thanks to him; [he is] the salvation of my countenance.

days.t: Where is God, who appoints the night watches?
x: But none said, Where is God that made me, who appoints the night-watches;
And Jacob was left alone; and a man wrestled with him till the morning.
And he saw that he prevailed not against him; and he touched the broad part of his thigh, and the broad part of Jacob's thigh was benumbed in his wrestling with him.
And he said to him, Let me go, for the day has dawned; but he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

days.t: He came in the fourth watch
x: And in the fourth watch of the night He went to them, walking on the sea.
And the disciples, having seen Him walking on the sea, were troubled, saying, “It is a ghost!” And they cried out in fear.
But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Take courage! I am [He]! Do not” be afraid.
Now toward midnight, Paul and Silas, praying, were singing praises to God. And the prisoners were listening to them.
